import os
from datetime import datetime

print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [no-guessing][csv-escape]: build CSV with selective quoting and required headers</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Assuming file_system stores CSV as plain text and accepts newline separated content.</uncertainty>')

# Build CSV content

def csv_escape(val):
    s = str(val) if val is not None else ''
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

rows = []
for sid, meta in song_meta.items():
    title = meta.get('Title','')
    artists = meta.get('Artists','')
    rows.append((sid, title, artists))

# Deterministic ordering
rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1], x[2], x[0]))

header = 'Title,Artists'
lines = [header]
for sid, title, artists in rows:
    lines.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists)}")

csv_content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('csv_lines_total_including_header', len(lines))
print('unique_song_count', len(rows))
print('csv_content_preview', '\n'.join(lines[:3]))

# Prepare directory and file
backup_dir = '~/backups'
file_path = '~/backups/spotify_library.csv'

print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [write-check]: check directory/file existence before write operations</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Directory existence check to avoid unnecessary metadata changes.</uncertainty>')

dir_exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=fs_token)
print('backup_dir_exists', dir_exists)
if not dir_exists.get('exists', False):
    print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [write-necessary-gate]: creating backups directory only if missing</playbook_cite>')
    create_dir_res = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=fs_token, recursive=True)
    print('create_directory_res', create_dir_res)

file_exists_res = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
file_exists = file_exists_res.get('exists', False)
print('file_exists_before', file_exists)

if file_exists:
    print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [write-check]: updating existing file content instead of creating</playbook_cite>')
    write_res = apis.file_system.update_file(file_path=file_path, content=csv_content, access_token=fs_token)
else:
    print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [write-check]: creating new file since missing</playbook_cite>')
    write_res = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token, content=csv_content, overwrite=False)

print('write_res', write_res)

# Verification gate
print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [pre-completion verification gate]: verify final file state before deleting account</playbook_cite>')
file_read = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
content_read = file_read.get('content','')
print('file_read_preview', '\n'.join(content_read.splitlines()[:3]))
line_count = len(content_read.splitlines())
print('verified_line_count', line_count)
# header check
header_read = content_read.splitlines()[0] if line_count>0 else None
print('header_read', header_read)

expected_lines = 1 + len(rows)
print('expected_lines', expected_lines)

verification_ok = (line_count == expected_lines) and (header_read == header)
print('verification_ok', verification_ok)

if not verification_ok:
    raise Exception('CSV verification failed; will not delete account.')

# Delete Spotify account
print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [task-follow-through]: terminate account after backup completion</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Interpreting “Terminate my account” as deleting the Spotify account via spotify.delete_account.</uncertainty>')
delete_res = apis.spotify.delete_account(access_token=spotify_token)
print('spotify_delete_account_res', delete_res)
